rationale: Both give essentially the same accurate overhead description: two clear blender cups on speckled granite containing strawberries, avocado, walnuts and blueberries, with a halved avocado and a knife blade with stamped text in the foreground, and a warm filtered look. Each adds a small unverifiable detail. A claims a metal blade assembly is visible at the bottom of the cups, which cannot really be seen from this angle. B describes a 'creamy greenish base, likely yogurt' in the left cup, which is speculative. Both call one strawberry in the right cup halved, when it looks more like two whole berries. Their accuracy and coverage are comparable, with neither clearly better.
